title: Example Course — Time-Synced Companion Video
sync_model: Each chapter animation's total run_time (plays + waits) MUST equal end-start to the frame. Scenes are concatenated in order and the ORIGINAL audio is muxed over the whole timeline, so exact per-chapter durations keep narration locked to visuals. Do NOT record TTS — the real podcast IS the soundtrack.
